subject: read.bismark Error in scan() expected an integer

messages.author: a9fc767a51d12e9a
messages.subject: read.bismark Error in scan() expected an integer
parts:
Hi all,

I am getting a strange error with the function read.bismark: 

Error in scan(file, what, nmax, sep, dec, quote, skip, nlines, na.strings,  :
  scan() expected 'an integer', got '52.38'
Calls: read.bismark ... read -> .local -> .readTableFast -> read.table -> scan
Execution halted

This happens when reading the methylation percentage per base for a sample.  It only happens in this case and not when I do read.bismark with some other samples.  Please let me know if any one has a clue or idea on what the problem could be.  I did check that all my SAMs are sorted.

Thanks for your time.

Best,
Rajat
